title: An erase that lands as predatesErase while recordSource still names an account records eraseSeen epoch 0, so a later draw silently disconnects Apple Health
evidence: An erase that lands as predatesErase while recordSource still names an account records eraseSeen epoch 0, because the store still holds the old record; only the erase's own answer knows N, so the fix needs erased(epoch:) passed from DataEraser.swift (off-limits). Effect: a silent Apple Health disconnect after a later draw, no data lost (S66 residual). ios/HealthRoadmap/Health/AppleHealthSync.swift erased(). US-72 AC10; US-25 AC16f.
